subject.title: Feature: Subscribe to WhatsApp call events (Baileys)

question: Should inbound WhatsApp call activity be exposed as a transient default-off event, persisted as contact history, or remain unsupported?
rationale: Source and dependency proof establish the feature gap, but privacy, consent, retention, and agent visibility are product choices that automation must not invent.

options.title: Transient opt-in event
options.body: Emit minimal sanitized call activity without persistence and keep outbound call permissions separate.

options.title: Persist contact history
options.body: Design a queryable SQLite-backed activity model with retention, deletion, migration, and user controls.

options.title: Keep unsupported
options.body: Decline call-event collection until the product value outweighs the privacy and maintenance cost.

recommendation.title: Transient opt-in event
recommendation.body: Emit minimal sanitized call activity without persistence and keep outbound call permissions separate.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest WhatsApp feature history, recent call-surface context, and prior issue-scoping evidence.
